nodes.label: Schizophrenia Six-Criteria Guideline
nodes.rationale: Characteristic syndrome, functional decline, 6-month course and three exclusions must all hold; no lab, imaging or scale establishes diagnosis alone.

nodes.label: Criterion A Characteristic Symptoms
nodes.rationale: Two of five symptom domains with delusions, hallucinations or disorganized speech required, so negative symptoms alone cannot qualify.
